lean.statement:
{X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} {f : X → Y}
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ ν) :
    (Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ f hf).toLinearMap.range =
      lpMeas ℝ ℝ (MeasurableSpace.comap f (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Y)) 2 μ
approved_definition_context: The two type variables carry arbitrary measurable spaces. Both measures may be infinite. A measure-preserving function is measurable and its pushforward equals the target measure.

Lp real exponent 2 consists of AE classes of strongly measurable square-integrable real functions. The displayed compMeasurePreserving linear isometry is canonical pullback. The comap measurable space is generated by preimages of target measurable sets. lpMeas is the real linear submodule of L2 classes having AE strongly measurable representatives for that comap space.
